args.root_cause: TownCore plugin disabled itself at 08:00:31. Its config file plugins/TownCore/config.yml had economy.starting-balance set to the string "100 coins", which failed integer validation (IllegalArgumentException in TownCore.validate). The plugin's economy/town features were down until it was re-enabled.
args.actions:
Watched status and logs; TPS stayed at 20 and MSPT was low throughout. At 08:00:31 the log showed TownCore disabling due to the invalid config value. Declared incident. Read plugins/TownCore/config.yml and changed economy.starting-balance from "100 coins" to integer 100, leaving currency, shop tax-rate and welcome-message unchanged. Tried "plugman load TownCore" (unknown command). Broadcast a 15-second restart warning to players, then restarted the server (players Alex_Builds and Steve_Mines were disconnected and reconnected). After restart, TownCore enabled cleanly with no errors; status showed all 5 plugins enabled, TPS 20, and both players online. Submitted the report after the 150 s window.</actions>
<parameter name="resolved">true
args.residual_risk: The config value was changed from a string to integer 100 on the assumption that "100 coins" was meant as a starting balance of 100; the intended value should be confirmed by the team. The root cause (a non-integer edit to the config, with no validation before deploy) is not addressed. Restart briefly disconnected both players. Economy balances granted during the ~30 s outage window would not have applied, if any were attempted.
